policies.title: Belize: table entries marked visa required
policies.summary: The current Belize Immigration table directly marks these foreign ordinary-passport nationalities YES for a Belize entry visa. The application route is mission/Belmopan processing, not eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: A Belize entry visa normally authorizes up to 30 days from entry; longer visits require the stated visa and visitor-permit extension process.

This excludes the 30-day US/Schengen/Canadian multiple-entry visa or permanent-residence-card waiver, residence, work, study, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document, sponsor and individual-admission routes.
Passport validity is more than six months and a return itinerary is required by the published requirements.

policies.title: Belize: table entries marked visa not required
policies.summary: The current Belize Immigration table directly marks these foreign ordinary-passport nationalities NO for an entry visa.
conditions: The central page introduces the nationality exemption for visits not exceeding 30 days; listed longer-stay thresholds must be observed where shown.
Slovakia, Slovenia, South Sudan and Timor-Leste are not assigned here because the live named table contains no row for them; no residual exemption is inferred from omission.
This excludes residence, work, study, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document, sponsor, citizenship and individual-admission routes.
Passport validity, onward itinerary and border admission conditions remain applicable.
